summary: Nocera, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into transaction agreements acquiring a controlling interest in QMAX Technology Co., Ltd. (Taiwan) from Chien-Hua Tseng via a variable interest entity (VIE) structure. No equity transfer occurs; Nocera obtains voting control, pledge security, exclusive call option, and economic/operational control. The seller retains legal title, and Nocera gains rights through a purchase agreement, proxy, pledge, call option, and business cooperation agreement. The filing does not disclose financial terms, purchase price, or closing timeline. Watch for regulatory approval, VIE enforcement risks, and integration of QMAX's operations.
